verdict.rationale: Sprinto docs show relevant building blocks — access review/monitoring dashboards (sprinto-docs-7, sprinto-docs-8), and a FreeAgent integration explicitly described as checking whether a departing user's access is offboarded (sprinto-docs-37) — which supports the leaver/access-removal half of the story. However, there is no explicit evidence of HR-system sync (e.g., BambooHR/Rippling) driving onboarding checklists, nor of training-completion tracking tied to new hires, which is the other half of the compliance-event story. Missing for 10: dedicated HR-tool integration for new-hire onboarding workflows, training-completion verification/checklist, and unified onboarding+offboarding audit trail spanning both events.
